claims.claim_text: the Auditor detects every injected fault (TPR=1.0) with zero false positives (FPR=0.0) across all fault types on frozen random instances

description: Self-audit: TPR/FPR characterization of the Auditor's own fault matrix (design 14). Every fault type A1-A14 is injected into N frozen random instances; detection rate (TPR) and no-fault false-positive rate (FPR) are reported with Wilson CIs. A TPR < 1.0 is a real Auditor bug. Real-scenario angle: the fault patterns mirror the legacy route failures and GRPO-Guard online faults.
